name: Call each NEW YEAR
source:
A crazy party simulator. An opportunity for the older generation to return to the days of student life. Sharp action, sparkling humor - all this is closely related to the complexity of the old games. Will you dare to dive into a world full of difficult choices? Can you make it through the night? To reach the end and find out what horrors an ordinary holiday hides in itself? 

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/875630/Call_each_NEW_YEAR]Steam[/url]]
translation:
疯狂的派对模拟器。老一辈人有机会回到学生时代。犀利的动作、闪闪发光的幽默——这一切都与老游戏的复杂性密切相关。你敢于进入一个充满艰难选择的世界吗？你能熬过一夜吗？到达终点并找出一个普通的假期本身隐藏着什么恐怖？

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/875630/Call_each_NEW_YEAR]Steam[/url]]
